OpenWurli DSP C++ port
Source: https://github.com/reales/retromulator
Exact revision: bb7ffd871c7c227aed0671ba39df8188a7a4697d
Upstream directory: source/openWurliLib
License: GNU General Public License version 3 (LICENSE.txt retained from repository root).
Each ow*.h header is retained verbatim, including its upstream GPL v3 / Rust
openwurli-dsp 0.9.0 port attribution. The upstream files do not contain individual
copyright-holder lines; none have been invented here.

Source selection: all sixteen ow*.h model headers; no device.h/device.cpp,
synthLib, JUCE, UI, assets/parameter descriptions, other engines or plugins.
The score Engine.cpp is a separately marked adaptation of the pinned device.cpp
signal chain, with native score lifecycle, MIDI and allocation ownership.

Asset audit: owPickupTables.h contains generated electrostatic 2D-field-solve
capacitance curves, not recorded audio. owMlpWeights.h contains the GPL v3
2-16-16-11 correction network weights, evaluated once per note. owTables.h
contains beam-theory reed parameters with calibrated model constants. These are
source model coefficients, not ROM images, sampled instruments, or manufacturer
patch banks. No external model file, ROM, samples or user asset is required.

Local dependency changes: none. Native adaptation initializes the same circuit
at the host sample rate; supports 44100..192000 Hz (the unmodified cabinet has a
20 kHz bypass low-pass); adds independent linear output Volume, 16 MIDI-channel
controller state, bounded 64-voice allocation, exact mute, reset and deterministic
render partitioning. Fixed-rate tremolo follows the upstream circuit, not an
invented hardware rate switch. Pitch bend, pressure, program changes and SysEx
are not implemented by this acoustic reed model. Native MIDI controllers:
CC1 tremolo, CC7 channel level, CC11 channel expression, CC64 sustain,
CC70 correction, CC71 speaker character, CC75 velocity curve,
CC120 all sound off, CC121 controller reset, CC123 all notes off, FF reset.
Upstream volume-pot modeling is exposed separately as Amplifier; output Volume
is a linear post-circuit gain. Model correction, speaker character and velocity
curves are explicitly software model/performance controls, not hardware switches.
Native velocity choices are 0 Linear (default), 1 Soft, 2 Hard, 3 Fixed.
Linear passes MIDI velocity unchanged into the physical model's response;
Soft squares it, Hard takes its square root, Fixed uses 0.75. The upstream
duplicate Medium choice is omitted. CC75 values 0..3 select directly;
values 4..127 select by integer division by 32.
Held-note lifetimes remain independently counted after voice stealing or natural
silence, so a late Note Off cannot release a newer repetition of the same key.
Channel All Sound Off does not reset another channel's pedal/controllers.

Redistribution must retain these notices and the complete GPL v3 license and
provide the corresponding source for the GPL-covered combined work.
